s: I am Maya, and this is my friend Lena.
Yesterday I made a simple lunch at home.
I eat beans for breakfast sometimes, and I eat beans for lunch too.
Do you eat beans in the morning?
And I like carrots with lunch.
I put carrots in soup, and I eat carrots with dinner.
Now, let me tell you about my lunch yesterday.
I went to a small cafe with my brother.
Chips are thin pieces of fried potato, and they are so tasty with fish.
Chips with salt are the best.
And my brother loves chips too.
He eats chips with lunch, and he eats chips with dinner.
That is a lot of chips!
Now, before we go on, let me tell you about a free app that helps you learn English every day.
The Muse English app gives you new words every day, with clear photos and easy pronunciation, so you can hear each word and say it well.
You can also listen to this podcast, practise with shadowing stories, play fun quizzes, learn grammar lessons, and win points on the leaderboard.
It is free, and it makes learning English part of your day.
Now back to our food story.
After lunch, my brother and I walked to the car park.
Where did you leave your car?
We left our car in the car park near the cafe.
The car park was big and clean.
It was easy to find our car in the car park.
A big car park is very useful.
What did you drink at the cafe?
My brother ordered a cold beer.
Beer is a drink made from grain.
A cold beer on a warm day!
Some people like beer with lunch.
No, I do not drink beer.
He says a cold beer is nice with fish and chips.
Beer with fish and chips is a classic lunch for many people.
I ate carrots with my dinner.
Carrots are orange, sweet, and healthy.
Yes, I ate beans for breakfast.
Beans, carrots, chips, and a walk to the car park.
It was a good food day!
Before we finish, here is one more thing about learning English.
The Muse English app is free, and it helps you a little every day.

You get new words with photos, you hear how to say them, you listen to this podcast, you practise speaking with shadowing stories, you test yourself with quizzes, you learn grammar step by step, and you collect points and climb the leaderboard.
Open the app, learn for ten minutes a day, and feel your English grow.
So today we learned five food words.
Beans are small seeds we eat.
A car park is where we leave our cars.
And beer is a drink made from grain.
Beans, carrots, chips, car park, beer.
Thanks for listening to Muse English.
